coverage_audit.method: Static caller/admission audit plus actual selected-slot diagnostics, prior direct parity/guard tests, and current pipeline pixel checks; not an instruction-hit-rate measurement.
coverage_audit.luma: 8-bit luma-like16-line prepared decoder edge with p2/q2 core; also reachable for444 luma-like planes and frame-only MBAFF MBs. Encoder luma still uses segmented LumaEdge, not this full-edge slot.
coverage_audit.chroma: 8-bit420 progressive decoder and encoder reconstruction,8-line complete core; other formats/depth/field/MBAFF excluded from this slot.
coverage_audit.average: Decoder BiWeightBlock mean branch; width>=4, valid rectangles, exact in-place or independent buffers; tails within width. Encoder still uses sample-level averaging.
coverage_audit.weight: Decoder P nonidentity and B single/bi block weighting; width positive multiple4, weights[-128, 128],offsets[-128, 127],denom0..7,depth8/10; wide/odd/overlap cases retain int64. Encoder sample-level weighting does not use this block slot.
coverage_audit.bs: A06 rejected; original bS production code retained.

local_allocation_probe.method: AllocsPerRun100 with new arrays INSIDE closure; PrepareEdge32/0/0/8 outside, mixed strengths1/2/3/4. Local probe source/log in tmp/a07.
local_allocation_probe.interpretation: Prepared luma wrapper conservatively escapes via function-value dispatch. Existing heap-plane reuse0alloc evidence is narrower than closure-local0alloc and must not be presented as such.
